patches.decision_note: Hook quality and the later permission to reuse one body with different openings are independently changeable and testable behaviors.

replacement.title: Impactful Moment Selection
replacement.definition: Source moments selected for clips must be strong and impactful independently of hook construction and standalone lesson completeness.

patches.decision_note: Moment-selection quality has its own claim, positive assessment, and later failure evidence distinct from hooks and semantic completeness.
Updating Notion with posting data and directly reporting a published Reel link are independently executable and verifiable obligations.

replacement.title: Initial Approved-Post Payment Threshold
replacement.definition: A temporary minimum number of approved and published videos must be reached before full upfront payment is released.

patches.decision_note: The payment-release threshold is a distinct business rule rather than a modification of the recurring monthly quota or general publishing authorization.

replacement.title: B-Roll Integration
replacement.definition: Provided B-roll must be integrated naturally where it supports the clip's message rather than being placed randomly.

patches.decision_note: B-roll use has an independent acceptance criterion and does not belong to source-video selection or general editing style.

replacement.title: Instagram Post Metadata
replacement.definition: Published Reels must use the client-specified caption, hashtags, and tagged Instagram account.

patches.decision_note: Post caption, hashtag, and account-tag rules are independently configurable from publishing itself, and the supplied evidence indicates a material handle conflict.
The ten-post condition governs release of full payment rather than general authorization to publish approved clips; it should be extracted under the payment-threshold Requirement.
The generic statement "It's done" follows several unrelated requested corrections and does not specifically claim that complete teaching moments were implemented.
The source reports caption-shadow and wind-noise defects, not failure of the approval workflow itself; those observations are already owned by the corresponding atomic quality Requirements.
